domains.note: no protocol or registration mentioned. Read Abstract, Introduction, Literature review, all four question sections, Recommendations, Conclusion and Disclaimer. No protocol, PROSPERO or registration wording anywhere in the text.

domains.evidence_quote: Most articles retrieved when searching for
domains.note: a search is mentioned but no bibliographic database is named, so the count is 0 and falls below the 3b-i threshold of 2 databases. This is a branch-2 high, rated on a safeguard that is present but fails the threshold.

3b-iii line 3: neither (a) a screening account with counts nor (b) inclusion/exclusion criteria is reported. Read Introduction and Literature review, the sections where a selection process would appear, and the rest of the text. No PRISMA, flow, screening, eligibility or criteria wording anywhere.

domains.domain: risk of bias assessment of included studies
domains.note: no appraisal step anywhere. Read Literature review, the safety section ('Will it increase the patient's functional or biomechanical risks?'), and Conclusion. Cited studies are summarised without any quality, bias or appraisal wording in the text.
no synthesis method is described and no quantitative pooling was done. Read the whole text and found no statistical, pooling, heterogeneity or synthesis-method wording.
no publication-bias assessment. Read the whole text and found no publication bias, funnel plot or small-study wording.

sources.fact_fa: این مقاله امتیاز ۵ و باند E (background / opinion level) در نوع سؤال THERAPY گرفت.
sources.interpretation_fa: این متن یک narrative review است و پایگاه‌های جست‌وجو، معیار انتخاب و ارزیابی کیفیت مطالعات را گزارش نمی‌کند. به همین دلیل امتیازش در سطح نظر کارشناسی است. ارزش بالینی‌اش در چارچوب تصمیم‌گیری برای تغییر OVD در بیماران دندان‌دار است، مثل رابطه‌ی 1:2:3 و ترتیب mock-up. این چارچوب برداشت نویسندگان است و یافته‌ی آزموده‌شده نیست.
